qualification_rule: Schema format checks are syntax prefilters only. Qualified RFC5646 validation requires a deterministic validator that verifies this lock, parses both complete IANA snapshots with exact redundant-tag precedence and registered extension singletons, reports matching Unicode data, and passes the registered language and Unicode vector cases. Package-content normalization, protected-span, Bidi, UAX9, UAX29, and UTS39 checks remain separate.
